name: hvnt33
description: Open-source investigation workbench: search every engine, capture evidence, archive the web, and file it into a graph with an AI agent. One app, with its server and database built in.

scripts.setup: node apps/server/scripts/setup.ts && node scripts/electron.ts && node scripts/runtime.ts && node scripts/tor.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:local && npm run test:token
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hvnt33/server && npm run typecheck -w @hvnt33/core && npm run typecheck -w @hvnt33/ui && npm run typecheck -w @hvnt33/desktop
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:core && npm test -w @hvnt33/ui && npm run verify -w @hvnt33/desktop
